title: Masa For Tamales (Easy Tamal Dough)
ldKeywords: authentic tamales recipe, homemade Mexican tamales, tamales dough
ldIngredientsRaw: 2 pounds lard (If you are using rendered lard you will need to use less broth)
5 pounds fresh ground masa (unprepared for tamales, divided)
2 to 3 cups broth from cooked pork roast or chicken broth (divided)
htmlIngredientLines: ▢ 2 pounds lard, If you are using rendered lard you will need to use less broth
▢ 5 pounds fresh ground masa, unprepared for tamales, divided
▢ 2 to 3 cups broth from cooked pork roast or chicken broth, divided
▢ ½ cup red chile sauce, only add if making red chile pork tamales
